gaps.sentence: They've set ___ a new charity for homeless dogs.
The protesters set ___ at dawn from the village square.
gaps.explanation: set off/out = begin a journey; set up = establish.

gaps.sentence: The film didn't live up ___ my expectations.
gaps.explanation: live up TO something = be as good as expected.

gaps.sentence: The concert tickets sold ___ within an hour.
gaps.explanation: sell out = all tickets/goods are sold.

gaps.sentence: Do come round ___ dinner next week.
gaps.explanation: come round = visit; come round FOR dinner/TO our place.

gaps.sentence: The publishers are bringing ___ a revised edition in the spring.
gaps.explanation: 'Bring out' = produce and publish a new product or edition.

gaps.sentence: You can count ___ me if you need help.
gaps.explanation: count on somebody = rely on them.

gaps.sentence: It took all morning to sort ___ the garage.
gaps.explanation: sort out = organize/put in order, or solve (a problem).
